AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-PROVE.title: Prove
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-PROVE.description:
Mark a card as genuine, to know that it's not disguised in [gold]Foresight[/gold].
Does not work on [gold]Obscured[/gold] cards.
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-CERTIFY.title: Certify
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-CERTIFY.description:
Mark a card as genuine, to know that it's not disguised in [gold]Foresight[/gold].
Works on [gold]Obscured[/gold] cards, preventing their disguise.
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-REWRITE.title: Rewrite
AJAMATRUTHSEEKER-REWRITE.description: Choose any number of cards in [gold]Foresight[/gold] to discard.
